title: CPC-2025-4421-CA
text:
CPC-2025-4421-CA  Council Districts: Citywide
  CEQA: ENV-2020-6762-EIR; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1;  Last Day to Act: 12-31-26
  ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD5
  Plan Area: Citywide
  Related Cases: CPC-2025-4430-CA; CPC-2026-4383-CA

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  Citywide

  PROPOSED CODE AMENDMENT:
  The Missing Middle LA (MMLA) Program proposes amendments to Chapters I and 1A of the Los Angeles
  Municipal Code to implement the City’s 2021–2029 Housing Element, incorporate state housing laws, and
  expand opportunities for smaller-scale for-sale and rental housing citywide. This Proposed Code Amendment
  includes:

  Update to the City’s Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) regulations, allow qualifying ADUs to be sold separately
  as condominiums pursuant to AB 1033 pursuant to a Map Waiver process, and establish local ADU incentives
  and size limitations; Codify HOME Act (Senate Bill 9) standards and procedures for Two-Unit Developments
  and Urban Lot Splits, including greater flexibility in how urban lots may be split.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Find and recommend the City Council find, based on the whole of the record, in the independent judgment
  of the decision maker, that the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and HOME Act Ordinances were assessed
  in the Housing Element Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2020-6762-EIR (SCH No. 2021010130)
  certified on November 29, 2021, Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1) adopted on June 14,
  2022, Addendum No. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2) adopted December 10, 2024, and Addendum No. 5
  (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD5) (collectively, “EIR”); adopt Addendum No. 5; determine, after consideration
  of the EIR, that pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines section 15162 and
  15164, no subsequent or supplemental EIR is required;
  2. Determine that the Proposed Ordinances are exempt from CEQA pursuant to Public Resources Code
  Sections 21080.085 and 21080.17 and Government Code Sections 65852.21(k), 66411.7(n),
  65852.28(e), 65913.4.5(b), and 66499.41(i), as applicable;
  3. Approve and recommend, pursuant to Chapter 1A Sections 13B.1.3 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code
  (LAMC), that the City Council adopt the following amendments to Chapter I and Chapter 1A of the LAMC:
  a. An update to the ADU Amendment Ordinance (Exhibit A.1) amending LAMC Chapter I Sections
  12.03,12.22 and 19.02, as well Chapter 1A Articles 2, 6, 7, 9, 12, 13, 14 and 15; and
  b. The establishment of the HOME Act Ordinance (Exhibit A.2) amending LAMC Chapter I Sections 12.21
  and 12.22, as well as Chapter 1A Articles 6 and 7;
  4. Adopt the Staff Recommendation Report as the Commission’s report on the subject; and
  5. Adopt the Findings.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Jeanalee Obergfell, City Planner
  planning.missingmiddlela@lacity.org
  (213) 978-0092
summary: The City Planning Commission would recommend citywide changes to accessory dwelling unit rules, including allowing qualifying ADUs to be sold as condominiums, and codifying state SB 9 rules for two-unit projects and urban lot splits.

flag.reason: Citywide ADU and SB 9 rules that change where and how small homes can be built, including in the watched neighborhoods.
